realm.description: The default Kerberos realm name (uppercase by convention).

dns_lookup_realm.description: Whether to use DNS to discover other KDCs in the realm.

dns_lookup_kdc.description: Whether to use DNS SRV records to discover KDCs (overrides explicit kdc= entries).

default_tkt_enctypes.description: List of encryption types to use for initial tickets (TGTs).

default_tgs_enctypes.description: List of encryption types to use for service tickets (TGTs).

permitted_enctypes.description: Encryption types permitted for encryption of ticket data.

max_skew.description: Maximum allowed clock skew (seconds) between client and KDC before authentication fails.

default_ccache_name.description: Default credential cache location pattern. Use %{uid} or %{realm} placeholders as needed.

realms.description: List of Kerberos realms managed by this KDC. Each entry configures one realm.

kdc_host.description: Hostname or IP of the KDC server for this realm.

kdc_port.description: Port for the KDC service (Kerberos v5 default: 88).

admin_port.description: Port for the admin server (kadmin) service.

default_domain.description: Primary DNS domain associated with this realm.

database.description: Database configuration for the Kerberos database (required for master KDC).

dbname.description: Path to the Kerberos principal database file.

master_key_type.description: Encryption type for the master key.

master_key.description: Master key (Base64-encoded binary key or plaintext passphrase). Should be securely generated and stored.

acls.description: ACL and permission file paths for kadmin access control.

acl_file.description: Path to ACL file defining per-principal admin access.

admin_acl.description: Principal(s) with full admin privileges (comma- or space-separated).

kadmin_acl.description: Principal(s) allowed to administer principals (comma- or space-separated).

support_enctypes.description: Encryption types explicitly supported for this realm. If omitted, defaults to default_tkt_enctypes.

domain_realm.description: Map DNS domains to Kerberos realms (used for automatic realm selection).

kdc_path.description: Log file path for KDC daemon messages.

admin_server_path.description: Log file path for kadmin server messages.

default_path.description: Log file path for client library messages.
